keep: The palette roles, type pairing, and spacing rhythm — the design language, not the pixels.
Component vocabulary hints (buttons, cards, nav) as a checklist, not as markup.
replace: All copy, imagery, logos, and distinctive artwork with the customer's own content.
Fonts with licensed equivalents unless the source font is verifiably self-hostable.
remix: Shift the accent hue by roughly 10 degrees and pick the customer's own brand neutrals — visibly theirs, not a copy.
Let the customer's real content (products, posts, pages) drive the layout; apply the language to it.

pins.why: The hero band and every source button paint #dd3333 (measured); the extractor read an unresolved --e-global-color-accent as #000000.
Source buttons measure rgb(221,51,51); the extracted #d9534f is the builder default, 12 units off.
Body copy measures #2d3748 (11.44:1 on the #f7fafc page). The extracted #7a7a7a measures 4.10:1 and fails AA 1.4.3.
Reading copy and headings both render Montserrat (measured 12 paragraphs + 8 headings at 17px w400). The extracted "eicons" is Elementor's icon font, never a body face.

The hero bandbgColor extracts as var( --e-global-color-accent ), which the renderer cannot resolve, so the band painted nothing and its white 55px headline sat on the page background. The band measures rgb(221,51,51).
